title: Fujiya Hotel
scope: Standing Fujiya Hotel’s main Miyanoshita hillside complex after the 2020 reopening, including the 1891 Main, Dining Room, Comfy Lodge and Restful Cottage, Flower Palace, Cascade Wing and Forest Wing.
limitations: Six principal buildings are modeled in the main compound. The detached Kikka-so across the road, shops, interior fittings and small garden structures are outside scope.

Facade and roof profiles draw from the named current buildings, historic records and the hotel’s restoration descriptions. Later wing heights, balcony sequences, exact trim shades and small windows are approximate.
The discrete building datums follow the national elevation survey. Retaining walls, courtyard steps and interpolated ground beneath the buildings are approximations.
